description: Main source file for a Flutter application implementing a simple login, sign-up, and calculator dashboard with in-memory user management.

classes.name: CalculatorApp
classes.description: Root widget for the calculator application, setting up theme and initial navigation.

classes.name: _AppShellState
classes.description: Manages app state, including user authentication, navigation between login/signup/dashboard, and calculator operations.

classes.name: _PersistentHeader
classes.description: Displays a persistent header with the app title.

classes.name: _CardContainer
classes.description: Provides a styled container for various cards in the UI.

classes.name: _DashboardCard
classes.description: UI for calculator dashboard, including input fields, buttons, and result display.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes the Flutter app with CalculatorApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for each component, e.g., CalculatorApp, _AppShellState, etc.

methods.name: _onLoginPressed
methods.description: Handles login button press: validates credentials and navigates to dashboard.

methods.name: _onCreateAccountPressed
methods.description: Handles sign-up button press: validates input and creates an account.

methods.name: _runCalculation
methods.description: Performs arithmetic operations based on user input.

methods.name: _isEmailValid
methods.description: Validates email based on custom rules specified in the Kotlin comments.

methods.name: _showDashboardForEmail
methods.description: Sets UI to dashboard for given email.

methods.name: _onLogoutPressed
methods.description: Logs out the current user and returns to login screen.
